passages.title: Report Text: The Bali Myna
passages.text: The Bali myna is a songbird native to Bali, Indonesia. It is known for its mostly white feathers, black tips on its wings and tail, and blue skin around its eyes. The bird lives in open forest areas in the north-west of Bali. It searches for food on the ground and eats fruit, seeds, and insects. Bali mynas build nests in holes in trees. Illegal trapping for the pet trade and habitat loss threaten the species. Conservation programmes include breeding Bali mynas and releasing some birds into the wild. These efforts support the species, but it remains Critically Endangered and still needs protection.
